## Welcome to the  Hamilton County Courts

### Please Choose a Court

[![ham-cty-common-pleas-ct-logo](https://hamiltoncountycourts.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/HCCCP-color-logo-4.png)](https://hamiltoncountycourts.org/index.php/common-pleas)

## [Common Pleas](https://hamiltoncountycourts.org/index.php/common-pleas "Common Pleas")

Common Pleas Courts have jurisdiction in criminal felony cases and in civil cases in which the amount in controversy is more than $15,000.00.

[Click for Common Pleas Court](https://hamiltoncountycourts.org/index.php/common-pleas "Click for Common Pleas Court")

[![ham-cty-municipal-ct-logo](https://hamiltoncountycourts.org/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/ham-cty-municipal-ct-logo.png)](https://hamiltoncountycourts.org/index.php/municipal/)

## [Municipal Court](https://hamiltoncountycourts.org/index.php/municipal/ "Municipal Court")

Municipal Courts handle misdemeanor criminal cases and traffic charges, as well as civil cases in which the amount in controversy is less than $15,000.00.

[Click for Municipal Court](https://hamiltoncountycourts.org/index.php/municipal/ "Click for Municipal Court")

Please be advised that anyone entering the Hamilton County Courthouse must enter the building and go through a Sheriff’s Security Checkpoint. Between the hour of 8:30 A.M. to 9:30 A.M. patrons will encounter much longer lines and wait times. Please make sure to take this into consideration when determining your arrival time. Note:  Courthouse will open daily at 8:00 A.M.
